notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp5-6); transfers gross from the Total column (in 33,911, out 140,598). Statement 'Other' receipts 113,740 split into Tax Increment Financing 101,425 (TIF Fund column; printed as Tax Increment Financing in the Statement of Activities p3) and Other 12,315 (General 11,705 + Street 610). Fund balances printed (p6); beginning fund balance 1,647,795 is labelled '(restated)' with no restatement amount in the trimmed pages. Ending cash = Cash and cash equivalents 741,842 on the governmental funds statement (p4); restricted cash 391,938 and county treasurer cash 15,019 printed separately (not added); restricted certificates of deposit 495,772 as ending_investments. No prior-year cash printed, beginning_cash null. Business-type from proprietary statements (modified cash basis with capital assets and depreciation; measure net position); beginning net position 2,308,448 labelled '(restated)', no restatement amount printed; expenses total 379,230 printed on Statement of Activities p2; receipts total = operating 585,730 + interest 3,470. Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position (includes capital assets and debt). General Fund detail from the combining schedule by subfund column (pp15-16); the General Fund budget schedule (pp11-12) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Street Fund budget 'Property' 56,342 and Debt Service Fund budget 'Property' 126,664 split from their columns of the p5 statement. Zero-actual Debt Service 'Reserves' (budget 578,625) not recorded. Keno, ARPA and TIF funds have no schedule in this report (major fund columns on the statement only), so no detail lines for them. Utility funds have no budget schedules; no business-type detail lines (aligned with FY2023/FY2024). Read pages 1-16 of 16
